diff --git a/packages/opencode/src/util/proxy-env.ts b/packages/opencode/src/util/proxy-env.ts
index 6682b3ca1..e650444fc 100644
--- a/packages/opencode/src/util/proxy-env.ts
+++ b/packages/opencode/src/util/proxy-env.ts
@@ -60,8 +60,9 @@ function shouldProxy(hostname: string, port: number) {
     const proxyPort = parsed ? Number.parseInt(parsed[2]) : 0
     if (proxyPort && proxyPort !== port) return true
 
-    if (!/^[.*]/.test(proxyHostname)) return hostname !== proxyHostname
-    return !hostname.endsWith(proxyHostname.startsWith("*") ? proxyHostname.slice(1) : proxyHostname)
+    const normalizedHostname = hostname.toLowerCase()
+    if (!/^[.*]/.test(proxyHostname)) return normalizedHostname !== proxyHostname
+    return !normalizedHostname.endsWith(proxyHostname.startsWith("*") ? proxyHostname.slice(1) : proxyHostname)
   })
 }
 

diff --git a/packages/opencode/test/util/proxy-env.test.ts b/packages/opencode/test/util/proxy-env.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..eff1a1e5d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/opencode/test/util/proxy-env.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"
+import { getProxyForUrl } from "../../src/util/proxy-env"
+
+const original = {
+  http_proxy: process.env.http_proxy,
+  HTTP_PROXY: process.env.HTTP_PROXY,
+  all_proxy: process.env.all_proxy,
+  ALL_PROXY: process.env.ALL_PROXY,
+  no_proxy: process.env.no_proxy,
+  NO_PROXY: process.env.NO_PROXY,
+}
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(original)) {
+    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key]
+    else process.env[key] = value
+  }
+})
+
+describe("util.proxy-env", () => {
+  test("matches exact host names without case sensitivity, including ports", () => {
+    process.env.http_proxy = "http://proxy.test"
+    process.env.no_proxy = "EXAMPLE.COM:8080"
+
+    expect(getProxyForUrl("http://example.com:8080/path")).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(getProxyForUrl("http://example.com:8081/path")).toBe("http://proxy.test")
+  })
+
+  test("preserves case-insensitive suffix and wildcard matching", () => {
+    process.env.http_proxy = "http://proxy.test"
+    process.env.no_proxy = ".EXAMPLE.COM,*.INTERNAL.TEST"
+
+    expect(getProxyForUrl("http://api.example.com")).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(getProxyForUrl("http://api.internal.test")).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(getProxyForUrl("http://elsewhere.test")).toBe("http://proxy.test")
+  })
+})
